records.review_notes: The current decision question remains for discussion, but the spatial unit, mobility measure, and heat period need more input. Keep the current ranking unchanged pending stakeholder review.
records.sensitivity_summary: balanced top ten overlaps 9/10 with heat-only and 1/10 with proximity-only; The 60/40 top ten is strongly heat-led; emphasizing proximity materially changes its membership.
records.core_join_summary: 100/100 records analyzed; 0 missing coordinates; 0 NoData heat pixels; 0 unmatched core joins; 97/100 with measured-flow history
records.spatial_unit: individual managed-tree record in the 100-point feasibility snapshot
records.heat_measure: sample-relative WBGT raster pixel from the Brussels Environment mean 24-hour layer for 2016-08-24
records.mobility_measure: great-circle distance to the nearest bicycle counter, used only as a spatial context proxy
records.decision_question: Which observed tree areas combine relatively high heat-stress values with proximity to bicycle counters, and therefore merit more detailed field or mobility analysis?
records.measured_flow_context: nearest-counter mean 15-minute count for 2024-01-01 through 2024-01-07 where a committed counter history exists; contextual only
records.output_boundary: descriptive follow-up screening; not a planting recommendation, priority list, optimization, street-use estimate or causal finding
records.proposed_stakeholder: Brussels urban greening or heat-adaptation team
